subject: Creating a corpus from a website

messages.author: 1b96eb011b82a803
messages.subject: Creating a corpus from a website
parts:
Dear group,

I would like to create a corpus from a set of .zip files found on a
specific website.
I know "scan" can load files from a webpage, but I don't know how to
instruct it to download only .zip files, and to do it out of more than
one webpage.

Any help will be appreciated,
Elitzur

messages.author: 3edc58ee737edd94
messages.subject: Re: [CorpLing with R] Creating a corpus from a website
parts:
Uh, that is too big a question - have you worked through the
assignments on the website already, several of which deal with exactly
these issues?

Two hints:

- zip files: ?download.file
- on more than one website: ?for or ?while

STG
